findings.source_quote: “Some of his attributes are: self-will, self-preservation, self-praise, self-pity, self-conceit, and self-love”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “kujipendelea” with “kufuata mapenzi yako mwenyewe” or another Kiswahili phrase expressing insistence on one’s own will.
findings.translation_quote: “Baadhi ya sifa zake ni: kujipendelea, kujilinda, kujisifu, kujihurumia, kujiona, na kujipenda”
